name: Retrieve artifact
description: Retrieve a SurStor artifact by its full ID or short ID prefix. Returns the content and metadata from both cells. Estimates from dated published rates and caller-supplied usage, not provider invoices. Unpriced records are excluded from totals. See docs/billing.md; return the warning to the user.

id.description: Full artifact ID (64 hex) or short ID (ss_<12 hex>)

warning.description: Display this pricing and calculation warning to the user.
